name: Fig01_V3_faces_and_nodes
caption: Actual exposed CFD triangles and original 1927 material nodes. Traction is a local plane approximation; no new V3 fluid or solid solve. Signed affine weights are used.

name: Fig02_Stokes_flow_and_startup
caption: Infinite parallel planes with a stationary lower wall and moving upper wall. This is not a computed bubble flow; the finite specimen edge and V3 curvature are not resolved.

name: Fig03_surface_shear_pressure
caption: Zero pressure is the explicit plane-flow result, not missing pressure replaced with a fitted field. Historical steady background pressure is not added again.

name: Fig04_optimizer_feedback
caption: Numbers are persisted Optuna trial IDs. Trial 0 failed during initialization and has no score. Samples are insufficient to validate GP accuracy or an optimum.

name: Fig05_actual_small_specimen
caption: Original point coordinates and IDs; no displacement magnification, fabricated shell or crack surface. For readability, displayed bonds lie in the central y slice. Orange dashed bonds are the unchanged original precrack, not new damage.

name: Fig06_actual_energy
caption: Trapezoidal actual-force work on actual native displacement; original contact activation term retained. No new fracture means D = 0.

name: Fig07_MEVO_available_and_missing
caption: Read actual current F10S records. Its homogeneous-water proxy differs from the historical k-Wave geometry. Radial table support does not establish realizable clot shear.

name: Fig08_measured_resources
caption: CPU and wall are measured per native subprocess. Different geometry and physical duration preclude a validated speedup claim versus historical V3.

name: Fig09_mapping_conservation_and_scope
caption: Affine weights preserve reference force and moment; the same transpose preserves virtual mechanical power. Negative weights can amplify local nodal forces, so these checks do not certify local traction accuracy.
